business_summary: O-Well Corporation engages in coating and electronics related business in Japan. The company offers paint and coating materials, coating equipment, pollution control equipment, special equipment, painting/coating devices/tools, metallic surface treatment agents, and measuring devices. It also provides tapes, adhesives, plastic moldings, plastic foamed products, ceramic products, mats, heat-resistant materials, protective films, functional films, decoration films, anti-scattering films, marking films, filters, honeycomb cores, antibacterial agents, antimolds agent, rustproof oils, waterproof materials, sealants, lining materials, polishing materials, grinding materials, flaw detection materials, damping materials, soundproof materials, reflectors, antistatic products, fluorinated high-performance liquids, inactive liquids, antistatic agents, surfactants, inks, chemicals, cleaners, building materials, raw materials, optical parts, and other electrical and electronic materials. In addition, the company offers semiconductor-related products, such as hall ICs, microcontrollers, and motor drivers; RFID-related readers and sensor tags; distance, temperature, humidity, pressure, CO2, capacitance, and infrared sensors; electrical and electronic mechanical components; and other products. Further, it provides contracting and design/supervision of various incidental construction work. The company was formerly known as Ohmiya Kogyo Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to O-Well Corporation in 1992. O-Well Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
